Kamil does not mention who told him so and with what proof?

Amin Kamil, as also Akhtar Mohi-ud-Din, view verse should read 'khasvûní margû tu vasvûní bàlò'. They use as proof bungling by Mr. Kaul.
- Literary, a 'marg' is plain area top mountain or between mountains, can only be crossed and not ascended. Hence 'tarvûní margû' more authentic.
- Let me know views... title.
